notes.title: Devlog 01: Deck-building Festival and Development Progress Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860824/e76fcf26fc6295ca7ae26b7bc949676023306490.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone, it's been a while!

I'm here to share some good news with you all — [b] "INDIES 2: BURNING KINDLING " has now joined the Steam Deck-building Festival![/b]

By the way, development of the game is going smoothly, pretty much as we expected!

The foundational features of the chess-strategy part have been completed, and next up, we'll be focusing on the DBG (Deck-building Game) aspect, as well as the Roguelike elements.

Here are some little teasers, of course, the game screenshots are not final versions~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860824/e63b7afe02a5e8411a6bab20b697144042a62d1e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860824/235197dd3f4380f195ef25e4b0e8d12270c44d24.jpg[/img]

So, [b]if you're also interested in "INDIES 2: BURNING KINDLING," be sure to add it to your Steam wishlist![/b]

Wishing you all a happy day!

——Coffee
